predictor_input: One deciding owner's actual initial observe_protocol value
That owner's exact planning_snapshot command endpoint and immutable submitted request
Only the planning snapshots actually delivered to that owner
One action from the unchanged public32 candidate domain
later_context_input: One current owner view, own command endpoint, selected delivered peer envelope
That owner's retained five-job public contract ledger
That owner's ordered immutable submission prefix only
Explicit phase, publication request ID, selected native message ID, collection and quiet start
context_authority: Pure supplied-data validation only. The existing native wrapper must authenticate actual LocalTransport/session/admission and exact endpoint reads before any future online dispatch. A SuppliedContext integrity envelope is not that native capability.

physical_model.unchanged: Original physics run statements remain private-AST derived, including every heap pop, global START+i*PERIOD tick, service arithmetic, capacity/FIFO/scorer/default-best-ranked behavior and event budget.
physical_model.new: Explicit future publication capture, recipient delivery, own ACK, demand updates, preflight immutable retry, owner quiet periods and at most one fresh pair per deciding phase.
physical_model.initial_available_assumption: In the closed published three-tray start fixture, underlying initial available_at is0 for all trays. Loading snapshot available_at instead exposes observed LOAD_START+duration. This finite-domain initial assumption is separate from those observed source fields; arbitrary hidden initial-history worlds remain unsupported.

forecast_data: Projected v3 rows are generated only after corresponding pure model events have been processed. They are visibly conditional predictions and do not assert actual delivery or future-state certainty. No future-event-heap inspection supplies a field.
existing_guard_reuse: Future projected pair uses the same historical pure endpoint guard
Future failed-read eligibility calls the unchanged live_obligation_unloading_policy.retry_admission
A scheduled unloading end never creates a terminal completion receipt; modeled UNLOAD_COMPLETE must have occurred before a source captures and delivers it

retrospective_gate.unknown_rule: Retain every failed, unknown, mismatched, unexecuted or timed-out row. All96 must pass before complete-domain conformance is claimed.
retrospective_gate.targets_only: Saved actual future collection records and five completion endpoints are verifier targets only, evaluated after predictor returns. They are not passed into the predictor, source-capture constructor or action logic.
retrospective_gate.exactness: Same complete five-job key set, finite native float types and exact float hex values; ordered phase/owner/attempt clocks and information classifications. No epsilon or fitted per-case time correction.
retrospective_gate.not_held_out: All96 are retrospective semantic conformance/regression material, not statistically independent held-out validation.

remaining_limits: Even exact96 agreement is not a calibrated error bound outside this finite synthetic domain.
No native fork, remote private endpoint or saved optimum lookup may choose online actions.
No new strong search, online campaign, 100ms claim or method-necessity claim before this conformance gate closes.
The original airport input and all old93 runtime sources remain unchanged.
